strings.zh: 小葵『来啦,我是小葵！{SCROLL}知道一档叫“暗语”的{NEWLINE}电台节目吗？{SCROLL}只要你告诉我{NEWLINE}这个节目里播出的暗语{CLEAR}就能得到点数,{SCROLL}积累了这些点数,{NEWLINE}去那边那个姐姐那儿{CLEAR}就能得到{CLEAR}精美的礼品！{SCROLL}给！{SCROLL}这是存点数的卡！{NEWLINE}送给你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Hi! I’m Buena! Do you know about{NEWLINE}the radio show called Buena’s Password?{CLEAR}If you can tell me the password from{CLEAR}the program, you will earn points. Save{CLEAR}up those points and trade them with{CLEAR}that young lady over there for some{CLEAR}choice prizes! Here you go! It’s your{CLEAR}very own point card!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: RV037: addition: drop ‘sweet’ (zh just 那个姐姐)

strings.zh: 小葵『{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}谢谢你{CLEAR}经常收听我们的节目！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: {VAR:0103:0}! Thanks for tuning in to{NEWLINE}our show so often!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: RV037: omission: restore 经常 / 我们的节目

strings.zh: 小葵『谢谢你{NEWLINE}经常收听我们的节目！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Thanks for tuning in to our show{NEWLINE}so often!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: RV037: meaning: 经常 = often, not every day

strings.zh: 小葵『今后也请关注{NEWLINE}暗语节目！
strings.en: Buena: Tune in to my password show!

strings.zh: 小葵『今天的暗语{NEWLINE}记住了吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Buena: Do you remember today’s{NEWLINE}password? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 小葵『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}谢谢惠顾！{SCROLL}那么就像往常一样{NEWLINE}参加活动吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Thanks, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}Please join the show like you always do!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小葵『对不起~{NEWLINE}回答暗语{CLEAR}每天只能一次,{SCROLL}请你改天再来吧！
strings.en: Buena: Sorry...{NEWLINE}You get just one chance each day.{SCROLL}Come back tomorrow for another try!

strings.zh: 小葵『那么,{NEWLINE}收听节目后{CLEAR}再来吧！
strings.en: Buena: Well then, come back after you{NEWLINE}listen to the show!
strings.notes: RV037: addition: drop added ‘Catch ya later!’

strings.zh: 小葵『哇,谢谢了！{NEWLINE}嗯,你的名字呢？{SCROLL}……{VAR:0103:0}是吧！{SCROLL}那么{VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}也赶紧来参加活动吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Oh, wow! Thank you!{NEWLINE}What was your name again?{SCROLL}...{VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}Come on, {VAR:0103:0}.{NEWLINE}Join the show.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小葵『大家,开始啦！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}回答的{NEWLINE}今天的暗语{CLEAR}已经说啦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Everyone, here we go! {VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}has said today’s password!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: RV037: meaning: zh says the player’s password has been said, not a call to shout it; settles D-1651

strings.zh: 小葵『呀,回答正确！{SCROLL}你真的有好好收听啊！{NEWLINE}真高兴{SCROLL}那么,给你１个点数！{NEWLINE}恭喜！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Yippee! That’s right!{SCROLL}You did tune in! I’m so happy!{NEWLINE}You earned one point! Congratulations!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小葵『啊！蓝卡{NEWLINE}积攒了３０点了！{CLEAR}厉害,厉害！{SCROLL}……对了,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}已经{CLEAR}来过很多次了,所以我要特别{SCROLL}告诉你我的{NEWLINE}电话号码！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Oh! Your Blue Card has reached{NEWLINE}30 points! Wow, wow! ...Oh, right!{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}, you’ve come by so many times,{CLEAR}so I’m going to tell you my phone{CLEAR}number, just for you!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: RV037: meaning: zh: tells the number specially; no ‘today’ or ‘special deal’

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}记下了{NEWLINE}小葵的电话号码！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} registered Buena{NEWLINE}in the Pokégear!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小葵『我等你的来电！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: I look forward to hearing{NEWLINE}from you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小葵『啊呀{NEWLINE}可惜,答错了！{SCROLL}你忘了吗？
strings.en: Buena: Aww... That’s not it...{NEWLINE}Did you forget the password?

strings.zh: 在蓝卡中积攒点数,{NEWLINE}根据相应的点数{CLEAR}能够获赠精美的礼品！
strings.en: Save up the Blue Card points for some{NEWLINE}choice prizes!

strings.zh: 小葵『明天的节目{NEWLINE}也请收听！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Buena: Tune in to my show again{NEWLINE}tomorrow!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 恭喜！{SCROLL}你存到了{VAR:0133:0}点{NEWLINE}送给你{VAR:0108:1}！{CLEAR}请收下吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Congratulations!{SCROLL}Your points total is now {VAR:0133:0}. The prize{NEWLINE}is this {VAR:0108:1}. Here you are!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 蓝卡的点数已经全满了,{CLEAR}送给你新卡！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Your Blue Card points have reached{NEWLINE}their max.{CLEAR}I will give you a new card!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 得到了新的蓝卡！
strings.en: You received a new Blue Card!

strings.zh: 请继续参与我们的节目！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Please join the show again!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们２４小时不间断营业！{SCROLL}为了制作大家随时{NEWLINE}愿意收听的节目,{CLEAR}我也将２４小时努力工作！
strings.en: We’re on the air 24 hours a day!{SCROLL}To make shows people want to hear at{NEWLINE}any hour, I work 24 hours a day too!

strings.zh: 哇！您是联盟冠军大人吧！{NEWLINE}您打败火箭队的事迹{CLEAR}在我们城都地区也广为流传呢。
strings.en: Whoa! You’re the League Champion!{SCROLL}The story of how you beat Team Rocket{NEWLINE}is famous here in Johto too.

strings.zh: 到目前为止发现的精灵{NEWLINE}的鸣叫声已经全部收集齐了！{CLEAR}有２００种左右！
strings.en: We’ve collected the cries of{NEWLINE}every Pokémon discovered so far!{CLEAR}There are about 200 of them!

strings.zh: 门关住了……{NEWLINE}需要钥匙卡！
strings.en: The door is locked...{NEWLINE}It needs a Card Key!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}插入了钥匙卡！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} inserted the Card Key!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 精灵音乐{NEWLINE}主播世治。
strings.en: Pokémon Music{NEWLINE}DJ: Ben

strings.zh: 这是钥匙卡的插入口。{SCROLL}
strings.en: This is the slot for the Card Key.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 只要有钥匙卡{NEWLINE}这道门就应该能打开！
strings.en: This door should open with a Card Key!

strings.zh: 我还是挺擅长唱歌的,{NEWLINE}如果能通过广播台的选秀{CLEAR}成为一名音乐主播就好了。
strings.en: I’m a pretty good singer.{NEWLINE}I wish I could pass the station’s{CLEAR}audition and become a music DJ.

strings.zh: 台长受精灵联盟之托{NEWLINE}经营整个广播台,{CLEAR}业绩压力也是很大的。{CLEAR}所以有时候做事难免会心急一点。
strings.en: The director runs the whole station{NEWLINE}on behalf of the Pokémon League,{CLEAR}so he’s under a lot of pressure.{SCROLL}That’s why he can get a little{NEWLINE}impatient sometimes.

strings.zh: 从这里向上可以通到{NEWLINE}广播塔的最顶层瞭望台,{CLEAR}那里有精密的广播信号发射装置,{CLEAR}所以未经允许一律不许上去。
strings.en: This leads up to the Observation Deck{NEWLINE}at the very top of the Radio Tower.{SCROLL}The broadcast transmitters up there{NEWLINE}are delicate, so no one goes up{CLEAR}without permission.

strings.zh: 广播塔的每天都会有来宾进出,{NEWLINE}所以安保工作也很重要。
strings.en: Guests come and go from the Radio Tower{NEWLINE}every day, so security matters a lot.

strings.zh: 大木博士在精灵访谈节目中{NEWLINE}会提到在某个区域{CLEAR}大量出现某种精灵,{CLEAR}如果这时候去节目中{CLEAR}提到的区域看一下,{CLEAR}应该就能捉到该种精灵。
strings.en: On Pokémon Talk, Prof. Oak sometimes{NEWLINE}says a certain Pokémon is appearing in{CLEAR}large numbers somewhere.{SCROLL}If you visit the area he mentions, you{NEWLINE}should be able to catch that Pokémon.

strings.zh: 要成为一名主播并不容易,{NEWLINE}除了良好的声线之外,{CLEAR}表达能力、应变能力也都很重要。
strings.en: Becoming a radio host isn’t easy.{SCROLL}Besides a good voice, you need to{NEWLINE}express yourself well and think on{CLEAR}your feet.

strings.zh: 有４位数字相同。{NEWLINE}给您一等奖的奖品！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Four digits match, so you win the{NEWLINE}first prize!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 居然五位数字全部相同！{CLEAR}特等奖！太厉害了！！{SCROLL}……啊,还有奖品,{NEWLINE}太兴奋了我差点忘了。{CLEAR}来,给你这个！{SCROLL}
strings.en: All five digits match?!{NEWLINE}The grand prize! That’s amazing!!{SCROLL}...Oh, your prize! I got so excited,{NEWLINE}I almost forgot. Here, this is for you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: ……啊呀？{NEWLINE}道具好像已经装满了,{SCROLL}请整理好道具之后{NEWLINE}再来这里吧。
strings.en: ...Oh?{NEWLINE}You seem to have no room for this.{SCROLL}Please make room in your Bag and{NEWLINE}then let me know.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}等你很久了！{SCROLL}这个请收下,{NEWLINE}您的奖品！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}, we’ve been waiting for you!{SCROLL}Here you are. Your prize!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 请一定再来！{NEWLINE}我是你的苏治！
strings.en: Please do come again!{NEWLINE}Felicity, at your service!

strings.zh: 这里是精灵抽奖的抽签处,{SCROLL}要再试一次能不能抽中吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: This is the Pokémon Lottery Corner.{SCROLL}Would you like to check today’s{NEWLINE}lucky number again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你好,楼上正在录制{NEWLINE}我们广博台的新节目,{CLEAR}暂时谢绝游客参观。
strings.en: Hello. A new show for our station is{NEWLINE}being recorded upstairs, so visitors{CLEAR}can’t go up for now.
